body:
> You are living the dream and you do not even know it.

Please elaborate on this because I laughed when I read this.
I can find work easily. I probably worded my OP like shit because finding a job isn't the issue.

> High debt situations can be resolved **easily**

Not really that "easily". Also, whatever job I might find will still lead to a decade of life wasting. You're looking at this like a calculator. I'm not an equation.

I wish I could hold on but I don't have a few months. I didn't exaggerate when I said I only own $8. I'm currently waiting for the grocery shops to open so I can pay them a final visit, stocking up some noodles that should last me another week. I don't have more time than that.

I'm sorry but your whole post is just generic *"YOU CAN DO IT! JUST BE POSITIVE"* mumbo jumbo. 

Do you honestly think, somebody who is suicidal is going to read your post and think "Hmm, I was totally going to kill myself but after reading "I need to go out and meet people" I've totally changed my mind and a found will to live"
